title: Prompt moja, video ya kawaida

slides.headline: PROMPT MOJA, VIDEO YA KAWAIDA
slides.body: Ndiyo iliyonipata mara kumi. Hii ndiyo niliyobadilisha.

slides.headline: TATIZO SI MODEL
slides.body: Prompt ilisema: make a video about my app. Model ikajaza pengo kwa laptop, globe na gradient.

slides.headline: ANZA NA ARTIFACT
slides.body: Repo, faili, mstari wa code, au risiti halisi. Si mada wala wazo.

slides.headline: CLAIM MOJA YENYE UKWELI
slides.body: Sentensi moja yenye namba au kitu kinachoweza kuthibitishwa.

slides.headline: SHOT LIST YENYE SEKUNDE
slides.body: Kila beat ina muda, kinachosogea, na maandishi yake. Badilisha frame ndani ya 2.5s.

slides.headline: BRAND · MOTION · NEGATIVE
slides.body: Rangi na fonti halisi; 0.3 / 0.6 / 1.1s; orodha ya clichés zilizokatazwa.

slides.headline: TABAKA 7
slides.body:
1. Artifact
2. Claim
3. Shot list
4. Brand tokens
5. Motion
6. Negative
7. QA gate

slides.headline: COMMENT PROMPT
slides.body: Nitakutumia template na scene 8 za kweli.

caption:
Prompt yangu ya kwanza: make a video about my POS app. Nikapata laptop, globe, gradient, na code isiyosomeka.

Mara kumi. Tatizo halikuwa model. Ilikuwa prompt isiyo na kitu halisi. Sasa naanza na repo, mstari wa code na risiti; naandika claim moja yenye ukweli; nagawanya shot list kwa sekunde; naweka rangi na fonti zetu; kisha naorodhesha kila cliché iliyokatazwa. Tabaka 7, na QA mwishoni.

Code inayosomeka haitoki kwa modeli ya video. Inatoka kwenye render halisi: HTML, Remotion, au ffmpeg. Modeli inapamba tu.

Comment PROMPT, nitakutumia template na scene 8.

#CodeToVideo #BuildInPublic #DevTanzania
